verdict.rationale: Supabase's docs say the region chosen for a project determines where primary project data is stored, and they advise picking a specific region to meet jurisdictional residency requirements. Self-hosting via Docker Compose adds a second first-party route to full control over data location. Missing for 10: the list of available regions, clarity on whether secondary data (backups, logs, replicas) stays in-region, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: The region you choose also determines where your primary project data is stored. If your data residency requirements call for data to stay within a specific jurisdiction, choose a specific region
Deploy Supabase within your own infrastructure using Docker Compose.
